title: About ICST: Quality & Innovation in Thailand
description: Discover how ICST delivers innovative, customer-centric solutions tailored for the Thai market. Learn about our commitment to quality, reliability, and excellence in every project.

sections.heading: About ICST
paragraphs: ICST designs, builds, repairs and upgrades industrial cooling towers, and supplies cooling tower parts.
Our team of cooling tower professionals handles design, engineering, procurement, construction and after-sales service.
ICST provides full technical support for new cooling towers, repair and reconstruction, and thermal and structural upgrades.

sections.heading: ICST in Japan
paragraphs: ICST Japan provides comprehensive technical support for new cooling towers, repair and reconstruction, as well as thermal and structural upgrades.

sections.heading: Who we serve
paragraphs: We work with power, geothermal, refining, petrochemical, chemical, and pulp & paper, steel and metals customers.
